remainingIssues: The reviewer's own probe (stray-null-postmortem.mjs) was not re-run by me; it is not in the repository. The equivalent check is the journey's stray-null scan, which now runs on every audited page including the viewer postmortem, and passes.

The journey's stray-null scan covers the pages auditLayout visits plus the incident page and the fake draft review; the fallback-draft review (T3) and the 'Not found' / error states are not scanned. Those paths either use h() or go through appendAll now, but they are not asserted in a browser.
appendAll is only used where a conditional child is passed to a native append; other native append calls in public/js pass only elements built by h() and were left as they are.
.env.example is documentation only: the server intentionally has no .env loader, so it does not change runtime behaviour.
